AN ORDINANCE TO ESTABLISH THE DATE AND TIME OF THE FIRST YEARLY ORGANIZATIONAL MEETING OF THE TOWN OF CLERMONT, GEORGIA; TO ESTABLISH THE DATE AND TIME OF THE REGULAR MONTHLY MEETING; TO PROVIDE FOR AN EFFECTIVE DATE FOR SAID ORDINANCE; TO REPEAL CONFLICTING ORDINANCES, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES.

WHEREAS, the Mayor and Town Council of the Town of Clermont, Georgia is authorized by Article II, Chapter 4, Section 2-403 to establish the date and time of it’s regular meetings; and

WHEREAS, the Mayor and Town Council deem it in the best interest of the citizens of the Town of Clermont, Georgia to establish the date and time of it’s regular meetings:

NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT ORDAINED by the Mayor and Town Council of Clermont, Georgia, and it is hereby ordained by the authority of same, as follows:

Section L. FIRST YEARLY ORGANIZATIONAL MEETING.

The Mayor and Town Council shall hold the year’s first organizational meeting in the Town Hall at seven (7) o’clock p.m. on the first Tuesday in January of each year.
2: The regular meetings of the Mayor and Town Council shall be held at seven (7) o’clock p.m. on the first Tuesday in each month.
4: This ordinance is created by the Mayor and Town Council pursuant to the authority granted under Article II, Chapter 4, Section 2-403, of the Town Charter.
5: Should any section or provision of this ordinance be declared by the courts to be unconstitutional or invalid, such decision shall not affect the validity of the ordinance, as a whole or any part thereof, other than the parts so declared to be unconstitutional or invalid.
6: Where there is an apparent conflict in this ordinance between specific and general provisions, it is the intention hereof that the specific provision shall control.
7: All ordinances and parts of ordinances in conflict herewith are hereby repealed.
8: The effective date of this ordinance shall be upon approval of the Mayor and Town Council of the Town of Clermont, Georgia. 7B THIS _S ~ DAY OF_A@yz , 2002.
